title: Free and open source Unity Editor plugin for AI
author: billychasen
selftext:
If you've tried using AI with a unity project, you've probably noticed it starts to fail, especially when it needs to touch the editor.

Here's a [quick demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=taeGx0IDFrQ) of ione and you can browse the [code](https://github.com/TestcodeInc/ione) or [website](https://ione.games) too.

replies.author: Juzzaman
replies.body:
It worked once, for 1 prompt and then I started getting applicaiton.syncing or application.message windows from unity that took a very long time to disspear, I got sick of waiting and just closed unity.

There was also a compilation issue, one of the at `CaptureTools.cs` line 34, I just got claude to fix it and it compiled. Apparantly `FindObjectsByType<T>()` requires a `FindObjectsSortMode` parameter in modern Unity.

The fix was just adding `FindObjectsSortMode.None` as the required parameter to `FindObjectsByType<Camera>()`. The API signature changed in newer Unity versions to require a sort mode.
